sources.offline-core: Completed offline Core evaluation; approved handoff dated 3 November 2026.

notes: The ranked board uses only the 240 Core pairs (480 arms); all 20 model–arm entries cover 24 instances.
All add-on results use MRFoundry 0.14.0 at commit bd49b95.
Hard results are shown separately as descriptive aggregates for unequal cohorts, without task-level data.
Entry confidence intervals are Wilson intervals; paired difference intervals use the source cluster bootstrap.
The generated date records the frozen handoff date, not the time this file was rebuilt.

methodology.paired_trials: One baseline and one MRFoundry arm for each model–instance pair; offline evaluation.
methodology.difference_ci: 95% two-way cluster bootstrap over task families and models; 4,000 resamples, seed 0.
methodology.paired_test: Two-sided exact sign/McNemar test on discordant pairs.
methodology.entry_ci: 95% Wilson interval for a single Core model–arm completion proportion.

hard_cohorts.strong: Three frontier models; 15 families × two instances = 30 pairs per model.
hard_cohorts.other: Four further models; 11 multi-stage families × one instance = 11 pairs per model; no system tasks.

methodology.tokens: Token ratios are total with/without tokens and tokens per verified success with/without.

caveats: The Hard-tier difference alone is not statistically significant (exact paired P = 0.0614).
Hard results are descriptive aggregates: three frontier models have 30 pairs each; four further models have 11 each and no system-design tasks. These unequal cohorts do not form a common ranking.
Grok 4.7 was excluded because its API rejected the host's file-editing tool; nine started pairs are not analysed.
143 attempts (94 Core and 49 Hard) failed during setup before the first model turn due to a runner error and were restarted unchanged.
An 8 GiB per-process memory limit took effect partway through the runs; both arms of each pair had the same limit.
A known permissive image check accepts a zero-filled reconstruction on one hidden Hard instance.
Core diffusion completion decreased from 17/20 without skills to 15/20 with MRFoundry.
Timeout flags, reasoning-effort settings and repeated-run reliability are unavailable in the sanitized source and are not inferred from wall times or instance counts.
